blocks.html: Coming from the successful pilot run of pediatric vaccination for ages 5-11 last February 7, Robinsons Malls opens up more inoculation sites nationwide as it further strengthens its support to the government’s Covid-19 pediatric vaccination campaign.
Participating Robinsons Malls were transformed into giant playgrounds where they get to banter with mascots, play games, and bring home exciting treats.

To date, there are (11) Robinsons Malls pediatric vaccination sites nationwide including Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Place Las Pinas, Robinsons Place Dasma, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Place Tacloban, Robinsons Place Pavia, Robinsons Place Jaro, Robinsons Place Butuan, and Robinson Place Tagum.

Upcoming sites are at Robinsons Galleria Ortigas, Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Novaliches, Robinsons Starmills, Robinsons Place Gen Tri, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Naga, Robinsons Place Bacolod and Robinsons Place Roxas.
Follow Robinsons Malls official in Facebook and IG for more updates on venues and schedules.
